title: Kotak Surat di Dinding Apartemen
theme: Menyelidiki sebuah kotak usang berisi surat-surat lama di apartemen, mengungkap kisah masa lalu yang melankolis dan memaksa refleksi pribadi.

cover.prompt: An inviting, sun-drenched apartment interior, viewed through a wide-angle lens. Warm, golden hour light spills across a worn wooden floor, illuminating dust motes dancing in the air. In the foreground, a stack of old, cherished books beside a vintage ceramic mug, gently out of focus (shallow depth of field). In the mid-ground, a comfortable armchair sits empty by a large window, offering a view of a peaceful, tree-lined street (soft lighting, blurred background). The room is in the process of being gently decluttered, with some surfaces neat and others still holding a few nostalgic objects, conveying a quiet atmosphere of introspection and the passage of time. The overall feeling is one of calm, comfort, and a reflective personal space, composed with the rule of thirds.
cover.style: Cinematic photography, shallow depth of field, warm color grading

meta.plan_summary: A freelance artist discovers a hidden box of old, undated letters in her inherited apartment, revealing the melancholic and lonely life of a previous tenant, Nona Elara Kusuma, who mysteriously disappeared. The artist feels a deep connection to Elara's story and decides to keep it as a private memory, reflecting on the hidden traces of life within her apartment.
